article.linkText: Boston hosts Chicago in conference matchup
article.story: Chicago Bulls (1-1, 10th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Boston Celtics (1-1, seventh in the Eastern Conference) Boston; Monday, 7:30 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Eastern Conference foes Boston and Chicago will play on Monday. Boston finished 56-26 overall and 36-16 in Eastern Conference games a season ago. The Celtics allowed opponents to score 107.2 points per game and shoot 44.2% from the field last season. Chicago finished 31-51 overall and 19-32 in Eastern Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Bulls gave up 121.5 points per game while committing 19.0 fouls last season. INJURIES: Celtics: Devin Carter: out (illness). Bulls: Patrick Williams: out (groin), Noa Essengue: out (head contusion), Nic Claxton: out (hamstring). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
